recipes.name: How to cut cauliflower florets - efficiently, with least mess!
instructions: Cut whole cauliflower in half down the middle.
Cut the core out on the diagonal.
Use your hands to break into florets.
If you end up with some large ones, use a knife to cut into half or even thirds so all the florets are roughly the same size - this will ensure they cook through evenly. Use as directed by recipe!

page_recipe_notes: Recipe Notes: Nutrition is for 1 head of cauliflower for 4 servings. 1 large head weighs around 1kg/2lb and should yield approximately 600g / 1.2lb of cauliflower florets.
